/* browserGlass v1: generated file, do not edit */
/* page backgrounds are transparent (the DMS tint is behind them); images, videos and text stay opaque */

@-moz-document regexp("https?://.*") {
  @media not (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    html, body { background: transparent !important; }
  }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    :root:where(:not([data-color-mode="light" i], [data-theme~="light" i], .light):has(> head > meta[name="color-scheme" i][content~="dark" i]), [data-theme~="dark" i], [data-theme-mode="dark" i], [data-color-mode="dark" i], [data-bs-theme="dark" i], [data-mode="dark" i], [dark], .dark, .dark-mode, .theme-dark, :has(> body > #outerContainer #viewerContainer), :has(> body:is(.dark, .dark-mode, .theme-dark, [data-theme~="dark" i]))),
    :root:where(:not([data-color-mode="light" i], [data-theme~="light" i], .light):has(> head > meta[name="color-scheme" i][content~="dark" i]), [data-theme~="dark" i], [data-theme-mode="dark" i], [data-color-mode="dark" i], [data-bs-theme="dark" i], [data-mode="dark" i], [dark], .dark, .dark-mode, .theme-dark, :has(> body > #outerContainer #viewerContainer), :has(> body:is(.dark, .dark-mode, .theme-dark, [data-theme~="dark" i]))) > body { background: transparent !important; }
  }
}

@-moz-document url("about:newtab"), url("about:home"), url("about:privatebrowsing") {
  :root { --newtab-background-color: transparent !important; }
  :root, body { background: transparent !important; }
}

body:has(> #outerContainer #viewerContainer) {
  background-color: var(--body-bg-color) !important;
}
@@@@ end

  :root, body { background: transparent !important; }
}

      --browserglass-darken-bg: #101418;
      --browserglass-darken-fg: #f7f9ff;
    }}
  }
